# GitHub repository metadata

## Repository name

`IMacAsMonitor`

## Title

IMacAsMonitor — Turn an Older Mac into a Low-Latency Extended Display

## Description

Use a 2017 MacBook Pro or iMac as a low-latency extended display for Apple
silicon Macs over Thunderbolt Bridge. Built with Swift, ScreenCaptureKit,
VideoToolbox, Metal, and a virtual HiDPI display.
